Snapshot, JSON-LD, Microdata, Tables, and Framework pass previewConfig to SaveAsPattern; config-derived default names also use previewConfig.

AI Extract captures the submitted agent/mandate, description, schema, and captured page; save and AI-to-list request consume that snapshot. Late capture/start failures and streamed responses cannot update a navigated page.
